say:6:1410526001:1.text: What was that massive thing we just saw?
say:6:1410526001:1.source_cn: 刚刚我们看到的那个夸张的庞然大物是……

say:7:1410526002:1.text: That's the Super-Duper Hyper-Powered Mega Lift we've been looking for!
say:7:1410526002:1.source_cn: 那就是我们要找的东西！超级无敌强动力吊挂式缆索大型升降机！

say:9:1410526004:1.text: Glad you appreciate it! This beast is a true engineering marvel. I've seen its schematics—just its balancing system runs on a triple-link mechanism.
say:9:1410526004:1.source_cn: 很有眼力见，这可是件了不起的杰作。我曾经见过它的设计图...

say:10:1410526005:1.text: Actually, we owe this one to you Essail folks. This lift was probably built using the Ironheart Dominion's craftsmanship, with magic as its main power source.
say:10:1410526005:1.source_cn: 说起来，还是托你们艾塞勒的福，这座巨梯应该使用了钢心帝...

say:11:1410526006:0.text: Alright, enough gawking. Let's hop on!
say:11:1410526006:0.source_cn: 不多说了，我们快点乘上去吧！

narration:13:14010534:0.text: You discover a lift while riding the minecart.
narration:13:14010534:0.source_cn: 在乘坐矿车时发现一处升降机。
narration:13:14010534:0.male: You discover a lift while riding the minecart.
narration:13:14010534:0.female: You discover a lift while riding the minecart.
